'''Yelto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] onboard ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'' during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. She was part of a Republic battalion to reinforce [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] at the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] until the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was [[Attack on the Dorin's Sky|attacked]] by [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|White Nova]]. Once the ship was captured by the White Nova's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial strike team.<ref name="Flashpoint" />
